acceptance_scope: Candidate A is accepted only as a reference-bound raster for native reconstruction; this is not Office or native-artifact acceptance.

pixel_only_first_reading.finding: A coherent two-phase schematic with a central diagonal matrix and lower zero-shot comparison; calmer, more editorial, and less visually heavy than the baseline.

appearance_comparison.finding: Finer framing, restrained heading treatment, clearer matrix priority, coherent illustrations, and subdued warm/role palette improve hierarchy while retaining legibility.

seven_inch_typography.required_native_check: verify actual point sizes, rendered-font coverage, and post-render legibility

native_reconstruction_feasibility.basis: Visible components are flat, separable native primitives: text, rounded rectangles, grid cells, orthogonal connectors, dashes, and small vector-path illustrations.

nonblockers: Keep both dashed reuse links visibly separate and retain their encoder origins/destinations during reconstruction.
Verify publication-width typography, text extraction, connector endpoints, and rendered-font coverage in the native artifact.
Recheck delicate illustration contours and arrowheads after Office/native rendering.
stage_boundary: Raster acceptance does not accept or approve an Office document, editable artifact, native render, execution, or measurement.
